# Ombre Nails Spa

> Nail salon based in Austin, Texas. Ombre Nails Spa on East Riverside does impeccable gel, acrylic sets and cat eye art, and clients say Nancy's work holds up through cross-country moves.

- Phone: (512) 551-8611
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Del Valle, Manor, Pflugerville, Bastrop
- Yelp rating: 3.8 from 213 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/ombre-nails-spa/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/ombre-nails-spa/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Ombre Nails Spa is on East Riverside Drive, at the base of an apartment complex near Lady Bird Lake. Nancy and the team do gel, acrylic, almond shapes, cat eye and nail art. Reviewers say it's easy to get in, walk-in or booked, the service is quick and friendly, and gel holds up for weeks. One former neighbor says not a single nail chipped through a move across states.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Ombre Nails Spa?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 551-8611 or book online.
- Q: Where is Ombre Nails Spa?
  A: 1608 E Riverside Dr, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Ombré?
  A: Ombre Nails Spa is rated 3.8 stars from 213 Yelp reviews. Clients mention impeccable gel that lasts, Nancy's designs and easy walk-ins.
